Interface RowHeightProvider

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface RowHeightProvider

Gives rows their own height, e.g. room for wrapped text. Only heights that differ from the grid's row height are stored, so rows the provider leaves alone cost nothing.

Up to 1,000 rows inserted or deleted at once move the stored heights along, and only new rows are asked; updated rows are asked again. The grid asks for every row when more rows are inserted or deleted at once, when all rows change or are sorted or filtered, when the provider, the row height or a column width changes, and on Grid.refreshRowHeights(). For millions of rows it must be fast.

See Also:
